text:
Elaine (Marketing): Heads-up — planning to publish the 'Optimize: Performance Playbook' blog + press notes next Wed 10:00 AM PT. Need final legal signoff and CEO quote by EOD Tue. Draft below — please review and flag any risky claims. @Samir @Nora @Mike :eyes:

Samir (Product): Love it. Can we make sure the latency/cost chart is embedded and we call out Dedicated vs Hosted differences in one short paragraph? Also, want one customer quote — @Elaine can you confirm the one from Atlas is cleared? :white_check_mark:

Nora (Legal): I'll review the draft tonight. Please don't use phrases like 'industry-leading' unless we have clear support. Suggest we use 'best-in-class' or cite the specific p95 latency numbers. Also need a short footnote on the test environment and models used.

Mike (PR): Press timeline thought: embargo at 9:30 AM PT, blog goes live at 10:00 AM PT. Call with top outlets at 8:45 AM PT for briefing. I have an outreach list ready — will DM. Do we want a pre-release summary doc for press? :memo:

Elaine (Marketing): Draft social copy and short intro for blog (please comment inline):
```
Blog headline: Optimize: A practical playbook for cost-efficient, low-latency LLM inference
Teaser: Today we’re sharing design patterns, config recipes, and benchmark-backed numbers to help engineering teams get predictable latency and lower token costs.
CTA: Read the playbook -> https://redwood.ai/optimize-playbook
```

Samir (Product): Snippet for the Dedicated vs Hosted paragraph: "Dedicated pools give you predictable throughput and isolation; Hosted offers fast onboarding and burst capacity — our tests show Dedicated p95 latency at 45ms (seq=256) while Hosted averages 52ms under similar load. See chart."

Nora (Legal): That sentence is fine if we include the chart and the footnote. Add: "Results reflect our standard benchmark harness on x86 GPUs, quantized models where applicable; actual customer results may vary."

Mike (PR): Press list preview (top priority): The Verge, TechCrunch, Protocol, Wired, VentureBeat, Bloomberg Tech. I can add trade press and a couple regional outlets if we want. Also propose a short embargoed press kit: one-pager, high-res art, quote bank, FAQ.

Elaine (Marketing): I pasted the draft press kit into the /marketing/shared folder. Quick checklist: legal signoff (Nora), CEO quote (Samir to chase), customer quote clearance (Elaine to confirm), embed chart + footnote (Samir), analytics/tracking (DevOps), schedule publish (PressOps Bot).

DevOps (Infra): Tracking snippet and UTM tags are ready. Need confirmation on the tracking ticket ID to wire into the blog template. Also confirm POST endpoint for the publish webhook.

PressOps Bot: Scheduled publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-04-01T17:00:00Z (10:00 AM PT), embargo_until=2026-04-01T16:30:00Z. Job ID: 98374.

Elaine (Marketing): Great — Nora please drop a thumbs-up when legal is done. Mike please share the final press list in this thread before EOD Tue. Samir, can you confirm the chart PNG and the footnote copy by Monday morning? :pray:

Nora (Legal): Reviewing now. Will post final comments by 18:00 PT.

Mike (PR): Will share press list here in an hour. Also prepping the embargoed email.

Samir (Product): Chart PNG uploaded to /marketing/assets/chart-v5.png. Footnote copy: "Benchmarking performed on our standard harness; models and quantization settings are detailed in the appendix."

Elaine (Marketing): Perfect. Quick social cadence idea: 1) blog link on publish, 2) 4-tweet thread with key callouts + chart image, 3) short CTO quote on LinkedIn. Mike — can you craft the 4 tweets once the blog is live?

Mike (PR): Yep. I'll post the tweet thread text here once live. Also setting up one embargoed briefing for select reporters.

PressOps Bot: Reminder — add analytics ID 1284 to the blog template and confirm the publish webhook endpoint.

DevOps (Infra): Analytics ID 1284 wired. Publish webhook endpoint confirmed: https://hooks.redwood.ai/publish.

Elaine (Marketing): Final notes: keep headlines factual, include footnote, avoid 'best' language without citation. Thanks everyone — post any blocking issues ASAP. :rocket:

PressOps Bot: Publish job 98374 will run unless canceled. React :thumbsup: to confirm readiness.

Samir (Product): :thumbsup:

Nora (Legal): :thumbsup:

Mike (PR): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Marketing): :thumbsup:
